findings.text: The plan_review_edit_age docstring says the quiet period and the burst window both 'measure it here', but plan_review_quiet_remaining at line 2334 re-stats the file itself; a maintainer editing plan_review_edit_age would not change the quiet bound.

If _note_records raises partway, `answered = list(pending)` is skipped, so answers already written to disk are never committed; a later pass sees them answered and skips them, leaving the changed records uncommitted indefinitely.

justifications.durability: the two-days arm reddens under the recorded negative control and the sweep-vs-author assertion in tests/test_a_plan_review_composes_itself.py:247 fails if the review reverts to the sweep's session.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_plan_review_composes_itself.py re-run at 6eb9f86dd4 gives 18 passed; the live-store arm records the 30 s timing but its positive control is refused (a stored review already covers the plan), so that clause is unproven rather than measured.
justifications.fit: the pass follows the surrounding module idiom in reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2293 and introduces no plan, sprint or ticket identifier in any name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/plan_review.py:2708 compose_owed_plan_reviews composes only between the quiet period and the burst window, under plan_authoring_runs' newest session, and notes only reviews it dispatched.
justifications.reuse: the pass reuses recovery_review_subject.plan_review_subject, dispatch_review_for_run, record_response and ledger._commit_state_write rather than forking them.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff b9eab5cda3..6eb9f86dd4 is one of the six declared write paths, including the original fragment restored by the mandated revert commit e36c8b9078.
